cause_quote: PR #199123 removed `-webkit-user-select: none` from `.chat-thread` and added `.chat-thread` to the `-webkit-user-select: text` rule, making the inter-message gap selectable in WebKit.
user_saw: Double-clicking the empty gap between chat messages in WebKit could highlight a blue strip across the conversation.
summary: The fix clears selection on gap double-clicks and suppresses the gap highlight while preserving text selection across messages.
reasoning: I checked the stylesheet before PR #199123 and confirmed that selection was disabled on the transcript, with message text explicitly opting back in. PR #199123 made the whole transcript selectable to restore click-to-clear behavior, which let WebKit select and paint the newline in the gap as documented by the fix PR.
